adequacy.note: reference-independent: computed from the extracted facts + exported graph only (baselines/adequacy.py); the rule was chosen after seeing the data

robustness.note: post-hoc rule on nine systems: these bound the claim, they do not validate it

tier_b.note: reference-less systems: the rule applied, no fidelity to agree with

corpus_extension.rule: §12: report both; significance may not rest on the extension alone

recovery.note: post-hoc criterion (item 2.3): recovered >= 80 MoJoFM, failed < 50, else partial; classical = ACDC/WCA/LIMBO (all-common) + ARC (own subset)

rq2.win_rule: strict = candidate > every baseline in the set on that system; ties = >=; classical = all-common ACDC/WCA/LIMBO/dir/cc; all = + ARC (own subset) + LLM (rerun mean)

a5_paired_t8.note: declared-never-dropped ON vs OFF at min_weight=8; reference_recall_* are the §12 fidelity cost (C# only)

a6_llm_structure.note: §6.2 LLM-recovery = the A6 'LLM does structure' arm; itk absent = refused-oversize (graph > 1 context)

degradation.note: §8.2 induced degradation; OFF = the coverage-naive reading of the same diff (counts coverage-gaps as drift, ignores the advisory flag)

mutation.note: seeded §8.1 operators, L0-scoped labels; counts pooled across systems, Wilson 95% CIs (§12)

rq6_combined.note: mutate/combined.py: the §8.1 mutation set with evidence loss induced on the mutated run; one outcome per injected finding

rq6_history.note: committed rules held constant across each pair (they post-date the studied releases for squidex and nopcommerce, pre-date them for libxml2 — history-summary.json rules_note), L0-scoped runs; labels = findings both raters gave the label; kappa pooled over all pairs (pending until the worksheets are filled)

rq7.note: cold/warm = first/second `arch run --no-llm --incremental` into a fresh arch dir (baselines/rq7_perf.py); budgets P§1.1#6 (cold L2/L3 30 min, warm 3 min); peak RSS = whole process tree

rq9.labelling_rule: detection and expression numbers never cross (eval §10a.7)

summary_macros.rqTwoCsClassicalPartialList: nopCommerce: ARC 56.25; Squidex: WCA 50.0, LIMBO 60.0, ARC 50.0

tier_p.note: anonymized proprietary systems (eval §5.5) — corroborating only, excluded from every RQ statistic above (§14.3)
